## Tool

### Introduction

One or two sentences on what the tool does and what it's typically used for. If there is a paper to cite, add it to this folder's `references.bib` and cite it here, e.g. `[@authorYear]`.

For more detailed information, please visit [the manual](https://example.com/manual).

### Installation

Installed on Crunchomics: Yes, `<Tool>` vX.Y.Z is installed.

If you want to install it yourself, the command below installs the version verified on Crunchomics. Before running it, check the tool's [GitHub](https://example.com/repo) for a newer version and swap the version number if one is available.

```{bash}
mamba create -n toolname_X.Y.Z
mamba install -n toolname_X.Y.Z -c bioconda toolname=X.Y.Z
mamba activate toolname_X.Y.Z
```

If the tool is instead installed as part of the shared bioinformatics environment rather than its own dedicated environment, replace the block above with:

```{bash}
conda config --add envs_dirs /zfs/omics/projects/bioinformatics/software/miniconda3/envs/
```

and note in this section who to contact for access if a reader doesn't already have it.
